specs: Tickets must be purchased in advanced and can be purchased from our website (from the "Purchase Tickets" page).
Children 2 years old and older are required to purchase a ticket; however, our tour is recommended for children 13 years of age and older.
Some restaurants may have other beverages for purchase; some restaurants may have adult beverages for our guests 21 years old and older.

services.desc: Ticket is valid: Saturday, February 18 - March 4 Receive 7 treats within 14 days Exchange your coupons (PDF will be sent via email and will need to be printed out) for a treat at each sweet shop. The Midlands has some delicious dessert shops! Come experience this new, fun tour in which you travel around, on your schedule, and try the sweet treats they have to offer! The dessert shop decides what you receive; so it will be exciting to see what sweet surprise you will receive! Purchase your ticket then visit the participating locally owned sweet shops to receive a sweet surprise (in exchange for the coupon that you will give) at each location.
